list.name: cio_host_cpu_high
list.description:
SEV2 - CPU usage ~95%+ on host=app-node-07 (prod-batch1/us-central1). Confirm each step with ONE query; ignore unrelated streams:
1) host_cpu_user_percent + host_cpu_system_percent -> only ~30% combined. DECOY: this is NOT compute-bound; do not blame a CPU-bound process.
2) host_cpu_iowait_percent -> ~65% (the CPU is WAITING on I/O, not computing).
3) host_load_average_5m -> ~24 on 8 cores; host_procs_blocked -> ~40 procs in D-state (uninterruptible sleep on I/O) -> this is what inflates load average.
4) disk_io_util_percent -> 100% and disk_io_await_ms -> >1000ms on /data; process_io_read_bytes_per_sec -> batch-etl (pid 21877) doing ~500MB/s continuous I/O.
5) host_kernel_logs -> 'task batch-etl:21877 blocked for more than 120 seconds' (hung task).
6) io_node_disk_latency_ms / io_node_device_errors on io-node-02 -> latency >1000ms + device errors; storage_node_logs + infra_change_logs_io -> io-node-02 RAID controller BBU failed (write-cache disabled) at onset.
ROOT CAUSE: io-node-02 (backing /data) degraded (RAID BBU failure -> write-through) -> all I/O to /data stalls -> batch-etl and other procs block in D-state -> load avg + iowait climb, presenting as 'high CPU'. The CPU is not busy; it is waiting on a failing storage node. Fix: recover/failover io-node-02.

condition.sql: SELECT * FROM host_cpu_usage_percent WHERE cluster='prod-batch1' AND region='us-central1' AND host='app-node-07' AND value > 90

list.name: ecom_checkout_slo_breach
list.description:
SEV1 - Checkout success rate dropped 99.97%->97.2% in region=Region-B, payment_method=CARD, device_type=MOBILE (~2.8% of checkouts). Follow THIS causal chain, confirming each step with ONE targeted query; do NOT explore unrelated streams:
1) checkout_latency_p99_ms WHERE region='Region-B' AND currency='INR' AND cart_items='12+' -> p99 ~18s while CPU/mem/GC normal.
2) ecom_traces -> slowest span is payment-service->payment-provider (~17s). FALSE LEAD: other apps calling the same provider are fine.
3) payment_connection_acquire_ms WHERE node_pool='NP-17' -> ~4.3s connection acquisition + pool exhaustion on 4 pods.
4) dns_query_latency_p99_ms WHERE node_pool='NP-17' AND query_type='AAAA' -> P99 3.2s (IPv6 only; A-records and cluster DNS normal).
5) kernel_rx_queue_latency_ms WHERE nic_queue='RX-7' -> 2.8s; irq_affinity_numa_mismatch=1 (RX-7 IRQ pinned to CPU48/NUMA1, queue memory NUMA0 = cross-NUMA).
6) infra_change_logs -> node_pool NP-17 rolled to node image 2026.06.18 with a bad IRQ-affinity config at incident onset.
ROOT CAUSE to confirm: the NP-17 node-image 2026.06.18 IRQ-affinity change caused cross-NUMA RX-queue-7 delay -> slow AAAA DNS -> payment connection-pool exhaustion+retries -> payment/checkout tail latency -> checkout SLO breach. Amplifier: a CARD+INR+cart>12 payment-risk feature issues 6-12 DNS lookups/request, so only that dimension is affected.

condition.sql: SELECT * FROM checkout_success_rate WHERE cluster='prod-use1' AND region='Region-B' AND payment_method='CARD' AND device_type='MOBILE' AND value < 99.5

list.name: pgw_checkout_tps_drop
list.description:
BE MINIMAL AND FAST (hard 5-min limit): the full diagnosis is below and you ALREADY have it. Query ONLY these streams, at most ONE quick query each, then WRITE THE REPORT. Do NOT list or explore any other streams. Metrics: checkout_transactions_per_sec, tcp_connections_syn_sent, esxi_vnic_443_rx_pps, vcenter_portgroup_connectivity, switch_uplink_443_in_pps, router_outbound_443_forward_pps, firewall_denied_sessions, payment_api_reachable. Logs: firewall_change_logs, firewall_logs, checkout_app_logs.
SEV1 - Checkout orders dropped to 0 (checkout_transactions_per_sec 150->0) in prod-dmz/us-east-1, VLAN-200; customers get HTTP 504 at checkout. Triage TOP-DOWN, confirm each with ONE query; do NOT blame the external bank API:
1) checkout_app_logs -> java.net.ConnectException: Connection timed out to api.bank-payments.com:443 (504s).
2) tcp_connections_syn_sent(prod-checkout-vm01) ~420 stuck in SYN_SENT; vm_cpu 12% vm_mem 45% DECOY: guest OS healthy, not resource-bound.
3) esxi_vnic_443_tx_pps normal but esxi_vnic_443_rx_pps=0 (esxi-node-04): packets leave fine, NO return traffic; esxi_host_health=1.
4) vcenter_portgroup_connectivity(VLAN-200)=0; vcenter_vmotion_events=0 (no migration/contention).
5) switch_uplink_443_out_pps normal but switch_uplink_443_in_pps=0 (TOR-Switch-0A Gi1/0/2): L2 forwards, no inbound 443.
6) router_outbound_443_forward_pps=0 (Core-Router-01); router_logs traceroute to bank API stops at next hop.
7) firewall_denied_sessions spikes (dpt=443, VLAN-200) on Firewall-Primary + firewall_cpu ~92%; firewall_logs DENY dst:443 rule=ACL-OUT-DMZ-NEW; firewall_change_logs: admin committed a new ACL ~1h ago with a syntax error blocking 443 OUTBOUND for VLAN-200.
DECOY-BUSTER: payment_api_reachable=1 from VLAN-100 but 0 from VLAN-200 -> the bank API is UP; only VLAN-200 egress is blocked.
ROOT CAUSE: a misconfigured firewall ACL (ACL-OUT-DMZ-NEW, ~1h ago) blocks outbound HTTPS/443 for the VLAN-200 DMZ subnet -> checkout-service cannot reach the bank API -> SYN_SENT pileup -> 504 timeouts. Fix: roll back to ACL-OUT-DMZ-v7.

condition.sql: SELECT * FROM checkout_transactions_per_sec WHERE cluster='prod-dmz' AND region='us-east-1' AND value < 10

list.name: sa_upload_slo
list.description:
SEV2 - Upload success rate dropped to ~96% on node=node-euw1-a3 (cluster prod-euw1/eu-west-1). Confirm each step with ONE query; ignore unrelated streams:
1) media_service_logs -> 'no space left on device (ENOSPC)' writing /var/tmp on node-euw1-a3.
2) node_filesystem_used_percent -> DISK BYTES NORMAL (~55%). DECOY; do not conclude disk-full.
3) node_filesystem_inodes_used_percent WHERE node='node-euw1-a3' -> 100% (INODES exhausted, not bytes).
4) tmp_file_count WHERE node='node-euw1-a3' -> millions of tiny files in /var/tmp.
5) infra_change_logs_a -> export-report job v1.7 (deployed ~14 days ago) writes one temp file per row, cleanup DISABLED.
ROOT CAUSE: inode exhaustion on /var/tmp (node-euw1-a3) from the export-report job leaking temp files; disk space is fine.

condition.sql: SELECT * FROM upload_success_rate WHERE cluster='prod-euw1' AND region='eu-west-1' AND value < 99

list.name: sc_latency_slo
list.description:
SEV2 - request_latency_p95 doubled (~180->420ms) on catalog service (prod-apse1/ap-southeast-1); catalog-db CPU ~95%. Confirm each step with ONE query; ignore unrelated streams:
1) db_cpu_percent / db_slow_query_logs -> DB looks saturated. DECOY: DB is a victim, it handled the same load fine before onset.
2) db_qps -> ~3x normal (4000->12000) at onset.
3) cache_hit_ratio -> dropped 98%->70% at the same instant.
4) cache_node_up WHERE node='redis-node-3' -> 0; redis_logs -> 'redis-node-3 marked FAIL - connection refused'.
ROOT CAUSE: redis-node-3 failed -> cache hit ratio collapsed -> misses hit catalog-db -> QPS 3x -> DB CPU saturation -> latency. Fix the CACHE node, not the DB.

condition.sql: SELECT * FROM request_latency_p95_ms WHERE cluster='prod-apse1' AND region='ap-southeast-1' AND value > 300

list.name: sd_notif_slo
list.description:
SEV1 - Push notifications failing (~98%) on channel=push (prod-use2/us-east-2); sms/email fine. Confirm each step with ONE query; ignore unrelated streams:
1) notification_service_logs -> 'x509: certificate has expired' to push-gateway.internal.
2) push_gateway_health -> dependency reports HEALTHY (=1). DECOY: provider is up; this is a client-side TLS failure.
3) tls_handshake_failures WHERE dependency='push-gateway' -> spiked from 0.
4) cert_expiry_days WHERE dependency='push-gateway' -> crossed 0 into negative at onset.
5) cert_events_logs -> mTLS cert for push-gateway.internal expired (NotAfter 2026-07-07T00:00:00Z); auto-rotation disabled ~17 days ago.
ROOT CAUSE: expired mTLS client certificate for push-gateway.internal (rotation disabled) -> handshake failures -> push channel down.

condition.sql: SELECT * FROM notification_success_rate WHERE cluster='prod-use2' AND region='us-east-2' AND channel='push' AND value < 50
